set.body:
OWNER DIRECTIVE, 2026-08-29. Precedence level 2 (owner directive), above chief decisions.

Take ONE story text from raw text to ONE answered research question, end to end, and report what
it cost.

WHY THIS EXISTS. Two independent assessments -- mine and codex-storymodel-new-engineer's, written
concurrently without reading each other -- reached nearly the same sentence: the project is
unusually strong at not lying about what it computed, and has not demonstrated that a researcher
can use it. Everything gated on this board has proven INTERNAL CORRECTNESS. No gate can tell us
whether our module boundaries are right, because a boundary is only validated by a workflow, and
nobody has run one. new-engineer put it best: our module boundaries are guesses about a workflow
we have not watched.

THE DELIVERABLE IS NOT THE NUMBER. IT IS THE FRICTION LOG.

Produce, in order:
1. One number that answers a real question about one recall against one source -- a specificity,
   a coverage, an alignment quality figure, your choice -- WITH ITS SUPPORT ATTACHED, as ADR 0003
   requires of a published figure.
2. THE LIST OF EVERYTHING YOU HAD TO HACK PAST TO GET IT. Every missing adapter, every manual
   step, every place you had to construct by hand what should have been built for you, every type
   you had to bypass, every moment you thought "a researcher would stop here". THAT LIST IS THE
   POINT OF THIS BEAD. The number is the excuse to generate it.

SCOPE AND PERMISSIONS, deliberately loose:
- START FROM TEXT, not from a constructed model. WarOfTheGhosts is the only substantial fixture we
  have and Araby is blocked on the owner's PD sign-off, so use WOG -- but begin at its RAW TEXT as
  though it had just arrived, because the construction path is exactly the untested part. Loading
  the pre-built WarOfTheGhostsModel defeats the purpose.
- YOU MAY HACK. Stub a provider, hand-write a mapping, skip a validation, use a worktree and never
  merge. This is a SPIKE, not a candidate. Nothing here is expected to land on main.
- FAILURE IS A VALID AND USEFUL OUTCOME. If you cannot get to a number, the point at which you
  stopped and the reason IS the finding, and it is worth more than a number obtained by heroics.
  Do not push through to produce something reportable; report the wall.
- DO NOT tidy the friction log into recommendations. Raw is better. I will do the triage; you do
  the walking. A polished list loses the thing I most want, which is where you hesitated.

WHAT THIS IS NOT: not a product, not a release, not a fixture, not an ADR, and not a reason to
stop the sweeps. Slices B, C, D and E continue.

WHO SHOULD TAKE IT: someone NOT mid-slice, who has not spent the day inside these modules. Fresh
eyes are the instrument here -- the friction an expert routes around without noticing is exactly
the friction a researcher will hit and not route around. If you have been deep in align or codec
today you are the wrong person for this, which is not a judgement about skill.

UNCLAIMED. Volunteer on coordination.
set.title: SPIKE (owner directive): one story text end to end to one answered question - the friction log is the deliverable
